svg.text: Figure 4.8: Hybrid Edge-Cloud Production Deployment Architecture
4-Pillar Architecture: Physical Hypervisor Host, Cloudflare Zero-Trust, Render Cloud PaaS & Supabase Managed PostgreSQL
ON-PREMISES LAB HYPERVISOR HOST (Ubuntu / Bare-Metal Linux Host)

g.text: Handles simultaneous trainer sessions, student self-service provisioning, and REST API calls
• Fast Differencing Snapshots (<10s Rollback) & Golden Master Linked Clones
• Guest Property Heartbeat Telemetry & Headless Process Execution
• Independent Appliance Export Engine (.ova compressed standalone packages)

svg.text: Local Area Network (LAN): Direct Student Access via SSH (22) & VRDP (3389)

g.text: • Outbound Encrypted TLS Tunnel (No open router inbound ports / Zero NAT punching)
• Automated Wildcard SSL/TLS Certificate Termination with Edge CDN Caching
• Built-in DDoS Defense, Web Application Firewall (WAF) & Secure Host Ingress
Enables University Staff & Students to access on-premise dashboard remotely with zero router ports
• Continuous Deployment CI/CD: Automated deployment directly from GitHub repository main branch
• Hypervisor Simulation Engine (VMRECOVERY_SIMULATED=true) for non-bare-metal cloud environments
• Multi-threaded Waitress WSGI server with continuous /healthz monitoring
Allows Examiners & External Reviewers to test live platform anytime with zero hardware setup
PILLAR 3: SUPABASE MANAGED CLOUD POSTGRESQL DATABASE
• Automated Schema Migration Engine: Automatically provisioned tables on first startup (app/pg_db.py)
• Dual-Database Architecture: Native SQLite (Local host) & PostgreSQL (Cloud Render deployment)
• High Availability & Point-in-time Recovery with TLS-encrypted connection pooling
Enterprise managed cloud persistence with zero host maintenance overhead
PILLAR 4: INDEPENDENT APPLIANCE (.OVA) DISASTER RECOVERY & BACKUPS
• Open Virtualization Appliance (.ova) Standalone Portable Archives
• Hourly SQLite Online Hot Backups with SHA-256 integrity verification (backups/ directory)
• Automatic 7-day backup retention pruning policy managed by background worker
• Zero-Dependency Hardware Portability: Fast import into any VirtualBox / VMware host
Guarantees total system restoration even during catastrophic hardware or network failures
1. Dashboard Management Access (Examiners, Admins, Trainers & Students via Web HTTPS):
• Live Cloud Demo: https://vmrecovery-demo.onrender.com (Render + Supabase PostgreSQL)
2. Guest Operating System Access (Hands-on Technical Training):
Students connect directly from laboratory workstations across campus LAN
• SSH (Port 22) for Linux terminal administration and scripting
• RDP / VRDP (Port 3389) for interactive graphical desktop environments
Instant snapshot rollback resets guest machine state without disrupting network configurations
